# @mono-agent/observability-phoenix

Optional Phoenix tracing for mono-agent hosts, using bounded OTLP/HTTP protobuf
exports while local JSONL recording stays primary.

## Responsibility

Maps completed runs to OpenInference spans, generates deterministic trace ids,
serializes OTLP protobuf and posts to a configured Phoenix endpoint. The app
loads this package only when `observability.exporters` selects `type: "phoenix"`.

## Install / Usage

Install this package in the agent folder at exactly the same version as
`@mono-agent/agent-app`:

```bash
npm install @mono-agent/observability-phoenix@0.20.14
```

Keep the existing configuration shape:

```json
{
  "observability": {
    "exporters": [{ "type": "phoenix", "endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:6006/v1/traces" }]
  }
}
```

Programmatic hosts can import `createPhoenixRunExporter` from this package and
compose it with `createCompositeRunRecorder` from `@mono-agent/observability`.
The former `@mono-agent/observability/otel` subpath has been removed.

## Architecture

### Data flow

1. The host resolves the explicitly selected plugin and verifies its lockstep version.
2. The local recorder persists a run independently of the exporter.
3. A composite recorder replays bounded events and finishes the exporter.
4. Pure observability mapping produces span attributes; this package creates
   deterministic ids, serializes protobuf and sends an OTLP request.
5. Backfill uses the same serialization with historical timestamps. Doctor can
   send an empty protobuf request when a liveness probe is explicitly requested.

### Package structure

| Source | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `src/phoenix-exporter.ts` | Bounded exporter lifecycle and project selection. |
| `src/spans.ts` / `src/ids.ts` | OpenInference spans and stable run-based ids. |
| `src/serialize.ts` / `src/payload.ts` | Protobuf and SDK-free app payload boundary. |
| `src/transport.ts` | Native-fetch OTLP request with cancellation timeout. |

Metadata-only export is the default. With `includeSensitiveData: true`,
non-numeric values under sensitive-looking object keys are redacted; numeric
values under matched keys are retained; free text is not scanned by default.
`contentPatternRedaction: true` enables a closed high-confidence credential
pattern scan. Local recorder content scanning remains independently always on.
The original instrumentation scope is retained for existing dashboards.

## Dependency Boundary

Depends on generic `@mono-agent/observability` contracts/mapping and the
OpenTelemetry serializer/SDK. It is outside the default agent-app installation
closure. Managed runtimes copy the selected plugin and resolve only that
immutable app-side copy; ordinary installs prefer the explicit agent-folder
package. Missing or mismatched selected plugins fail startup with an exact
installation command; errors inside an installed plugin retain their cause.
Exporter network failures are best-effort and never suppress local JSONL.

## What This Package Does Not Own

Does not run a Phoenix server, own local artifact storage, schedule backfills,
or select whether sensitive data may be exported.
